text: I understand you are experiencing fatigue and itching. Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or dark urine?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of frequent blood transfusions, or do you consume alcohol heavily? I also need to know if you have been taking any new medications, supplements, or herbal remedies recently.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis and new-onset jaundice with severe itching, I suspect primary sclerosing cholangitis. REQUEST TEST: MRCP. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests.
